def get_user(uid):
    start = time.time()
    if not request.headers.get('X-Api-Key'):
        return None
    result = db.find(uid)
    print('get_user took', time.time() - start)
    return result

def delete_user(uid):
    start = time.time()
    if not request.headers.get('X-Api-Key'):
        return None
    db.delete(uid)
    print('delete_user took', time.time() - start)

class ReportBuilder:
    def __init__(self, title, rows, author):
        self.doc = {'title': title, 'body': rows, 'meta': {'author': author}}
        self.doc['header'] = ['Name', 'Value']
        self.doc['footer'] = 'Generated automatically'
        self.doc['columns'] = 2
    def header(self, header): self.doc['header'] = header; return self
    def footer(self, footer): self.doc['footer'] = footer; return self
    def landscape(self):
        self.doc['meta']['orientation'] = 'landscape'
        self.doc['columns'] = 4
        return self
    def build(self): return self.doc

report = (ReportBuilder('Q1', rows, 'ana').header(cols).landscape().build())

What changed: a positional parameter soup became a fluent builder; optional pieces are set only when needed and defaults live in one place.

def publish_article(article):
    slug = slugify(article['title'])
    html = markdown(article['body'])
    conn = sqlite3.connect('blog.db')
    conn.execute('INSERT INTO articles (slug, html) VALUES (?, ?)', (slug, html))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    s3.upload('posts/' + slug + '.html', html)
    purge_cdn('/posts/' + slug)
